workplace-types.statement: Workplace Insights has two types of workplaces: Discovered Locations (Internet & SaaS locations, including sub-locations, and inferred IP addresses) and Offices, which group inferred locations into a configured office with metadata.

quotes: There are two types of workplaces: Discovered Locations and Offices.
Discovered Locations are Internet & SaaS locations (a Internet & SaaS location can also consist of sub-locations) and inferred IP addresses
Offices are the grouping of inferred locations into a configured office with metadata.

recommend-office-metadata.statement: Zscaler recommends configuring offices with metadata for inferred-location workplaces for accurate insights; updated office metadata is reflected in Workplace Insights after the daily service scan, and the Overall Averages data filtered for inferred offices is estimated.

quotes: Zscaler recommends configuring offices (providing metadata) for inferred location-based workplaces to get accurate insights. After you update office metadata, it is reflected in Workplace Insights after the daily service scan.
If you've filtered the data for inferred offices, the data in this section are estimated as the Business Insights service doesn't have precise metadata to provide accurate insight.
## Overall Averages

occupancy-formula.statement: On the Workplace Details page, average occupancy is total visits divided by workplace capacity for the period, times 100, where possible capacity is capacity multiplied by the official working days in the time frame (capacity 100 over 5 days gives 500); metrics assume a 5-day work week.

quotes: The Workplace Details page shows various metrics such as occupancy, attendance, and footfall details for a workplace.
Average Occupancy: The average occupancy in percentage for the workplace within the specified time frame.
This is calculated by dividing the total number of visits to the workplace by the workplace capacity for the time period specified, then multiplying it by 100.
The total possible capacity is determined by multiplying the workplace capacity by the number of official working days within the time frame selected.
if your capacity is 100 and there are 5 official working days, the possible capacity is 500.
The metrics are calculated considering a 5-day work week.

attendance-formula.statement: On the Workplace Details page, average attendance is total visits divided by total assigned headcount for the workplace, times 100.

quotes: The Workplace Details page shows various metrics such as occupancy, attendance, and footfall details for a workplace.
Average Attendance: The average attendance for the workplace within the specified time frame.
This is calculated by dividing the total number of visits to the workplace by the total number of assigned headcount for the workplace, then multiplying it by 100.

terminology-formulas.statement: The Business Insights terminology article defines Average Attendance as total visits divided by the total assigned headcount for the workplace, times 100, and Average Occupancy as total visits divided by the site capacity, times 100.

quotes: Average Attendance: The average attendance for an office site is calculated by dividing the total number of visits to the workplace by the total number of assigned headcount for the workplace, then multiplying it by 100.
Average Occupancy: The average occupancy for a workplace is calculated by dividing the total number of visits to the workplace by the site capacity, then multiplying it by 100.

list-view-formulas.statement: On the Discovered Locations list, Attendance is visits divided by the possible assigned headcount times 100 and Occupancy is visits divided by total capacity times 100, both estimated for inferred locations.

quotes: Attendance: The attendance percentage for the workplace for the filtered timeframe.
Occupancy: The occupancy percentage for the workplace for the filtered timeframe.

This is calculated by dividing the total number of visits to the workplace by the total number of possible assigned headcount for the workplace, then multiplying it by 100. This value is estimated for inferred locations.
This is calculated by dividing the total number of visits to the workplace by the total capacity of the workplace, then multiplying it by 100. This value is estimated for inferred locations.

quotes: By default, Saturdays and Sundays are excluded from the metrics.

user-types-filter.statement: The Workplace Insights User Types filter does not filter the data unless user types are defined for the organization in Business Insights, and enabling it requires contacting Zscaler Support; the Workplace Details, Offices and Locations map and chart pages say the same.

quotes: Selecting user types doesn't filter the data unless you have defined these user types for your organization in Business Insights. To enable this filter, contact Zscaler Support.

time-range.statement: The Workplace Insights time range offers the last 7 days, a week, a month or 3 months, and data aggregation for the custom week, month or quarter might take some time to process.

quotes: View workplace insights for the last 7 days, a week, a month, or 3 months
The data aggregation for the custom week, month, or quarter might take some time to process.

one-type-at-a-time.statement: The Offices and Locations chart can show data for either configured offices or inferred locations at one time, and the Workplace Insights page says the same.

quotes: You can only view data for either the configured offices or inferred locations at one time.

evidence.after: to locate the configured office on the map.
quotes: You can only select to view data for either the configured offices or inferred locations at one time.

department-division-filter.statement: On Workplace Insights, the department filter is available unless at least one department is mapped to a division on the Department Mapping page.

quotes: The department filter is available unless you have at least one department mapping to a division on the Department Mapping page.

top-cities.statement: The Top Cities section of Workplace Insights shows cities by number of employees and office-visit frequency (remote, up to 2 days a week, more than 2 days a week), and can be exported to CSV.

quotes: the top cities by the number of employees and the frequency of their office visits (remote, less than or equal to 2 days a week, more than 2 days a week)
You can also download the data to a CSV file by clicking the Export

remote-user-density.statement: The Remote User Density view lists Potential Sites Opportunities: cities with the number and percentage of remote users where an office could be opened.

quotes: Switch between Geography and Remote User Density to view the following insights:
Potential Sites Opportunities: A list of cities with the number and percentage of remote users where you can consider opening an office.

map-missing-metadata.statement: The Offices and Locations map article says a configured office is missing from the map when its metadata is missing, and says to specify the city, state or province, and country when configuring offices to locate them on the map.

quotes: If you don't see a configured office on the map, metadata for that office is missing. Make sure you specify the city, state or province, and country information when configuring offices to locate the configured office on the map.

show-zia-sublocations.statement: The Offices and Locations map article says the Show ZIA Sub-locations toggle shows Internet & SaaS sub-locations in the list and is available when filtering for inferred location-based workplaces.

quotes: Enable the Show ZIA Sub-locations toggle to view Internet & SaaS sub-locations in the list. This option is available when you filter the data for inferred location-based workplaces.

discovered-locations-columns.statement: On the Discovered Locations list, a workplace with undefined city, state or country is categorized as Unknown; for Internet & SaaS location-based workplaces the City is mapped from the Internet & SaaS location configuration, with a MaxMind lookup used when no value is specified, and for configured offices it is mapped from the city value specified when configuring offices.

quotes: The city is mapped from the Internet & SaaS location configuration
location-based workplaces. If the value is not specified
For configured offices, this is mapped from the city value specified when configuring offices.
A workplace with an undefined city, state, or country is categorized as an Unknown City, State, or Country, respectively.
If the value is not specified, Zscaler relies on the MaxMind lookup to locate the city's IP address.

error-icon-reasons.statement: When no data is shown for a workplace or office on the Discovered Locations and Offices pages, hovering over the Error icon next to its name shows the reason, for example that the office is not configured correctly, metadata is not added, or the office was configured less than 24 hours ago.

quotes: If you don't see data for the workplace, hover over the Error icon () next to the workplace name to see the reason (e.g., the office is not configured correctly, metadata is not added, the office was configured less than 24 hours ago, etc.)

If you don't see data for the office, hover over the Error icon () next to the office name to see the reason (e.g., the office is not configured correctly, metadata is not added, the office was configured less than 24 hours ago, etc.)

footfall.statement: The Footfall by the Time of the Day section shows hourly footfall averaged for 7 days of the week when monthly data is selected, and its CSV export is available when the Time Range is Last 7 days or Week.

quotes: This section shows the hourly footfall information for the workplace for the filtered time frame averaged for 7 days of the week if you select to view monthly data.
Click the Export button to download the footfall data as a CSV file. This option is available when the Time Range filter at the top of the page is selected as Last 7 days or Week.

unassigned-users.statement: In Attendance by Department, the Show Unassigned Users checkbox shows data for users not assigned to a department.

quotes: Select the Show Unassigned Users checkbox to view the data for users that are not assigned to a department.

office-location-fields.summary: The map and discovered locations articles tell the admin to specify city, state or province, and country when configuring an office, while the office configuration article has an Address field and a 2024 release note says fields were removed from the Add Office drawer.

quotes: Make sure you specify the city, state or province, and country information when configuring offices to locate the configured office on the map.

positions.says: City, state or province, and country are to be specified when configuring offices.

quotes: Address: Enter the address of the office location. The address autopopulates in the drop-down menu.

positions.says: The office configuration article describes an Address field that autopopulates.

quotes: The Address field autopopulates when you enter the office address.
The following fields are no longer available when configuring an office:

positions.says: The August 30, 2024 release note says the Address field autopopulates and that a list of fields (City, Country and State/Province) is no longer available when configuring an office.

office-location-fields.impact: Which fields an admin enters so an office has city, state and country metadata for the map and the Discovered Locations City column is not settled; the articles that name those fields predate or ignore the removal.

day-of-week-metrics.summary: The Workplace Details and Offices and Locations chart articles calculate the Occupancy by Day of the Week and Attendance by Day of the Week graphs from different quantities.

quotes: This is calculated by dividing the number of users who came into the workplace on that day by the capacity of the workplace, then multiplying it by 100.
This is calculated by dividing the number of users who came to the workplace on that day by the total number of users assigned to the workplace, then multiplying it by 100.

positions.says: On Workplace Details, occupancy by day is users who came in divided by capacity, and attendance by day is users who came in divided by users assigned to the workplace.

quotes: This is calculated by dividing the number of visits to the workplaces on that day by the possible capacity of the workplaces, then multiplying it by 100.
This is calculated by dividing the number of visits to the workplaces on that day by the total number of possible assigned headcount of the workplaces, then multiplying it by 100.

positions.says: On the chart, occupancy by day is visits divided by the possible capacity of the workplaces, and attendance by day is visits divided by the total possible assigned headcount.

day-of-week-metrics.impact: Whether users versus visits and one versus all selected workplaces describe different scopes or one calculation is not stated, so a day-of-week percentage on one page is not comparable with the other.

attendance-denominator.title: What the attendance denominator is on Workplace Details
attendance-denominator.detail: The Workplace Insights, Offices and Locations chart and Workplace Details pages define the total possible assigned headcount by multiplying capacity by the official working days in the time frame, then divide visits by the total assigned headcount. Office configuration describes Assigned Headcount as a separately entered value that feeds attendance and Capacity as feeding occupancy. No source says which value the attendance denominator uses.

terminology.title: Workplace terms not defined in the terminology article
terminology.detail: Understanding Business Insights Terminology defines Workplaces, Assigned Headcount, Capacity, Average Attendance and Average Occupancy but not Average Span of Visit (Workplace Insights), Average Visit Span (chart and details) or Percent Mapped. The two span names may name the same widget; Percent Mapped is described only as mapped to the office from the limit and the limit is not given.
